1_rest.note: a fluid (or a rubber band) would still be flowing or ringing; a yield-stress paste has stopped

2_stream_thickness.note: the cup is held up to the spout, so the paste lands almost at once and keeps its thickness; an elastic rope would thin as it fell

3_stays_in_cup.note: grid-scale (one cell is 4.0 mm); the surface is pressed onto the paper afterwards

5_mass.note: each particle is created by the extruder and never removed, so volume equals the volume pumped

6_fused_pile.note: low: the coils fused into one body instead of leaving air gaps
